zh-CN.title: 小程序同步近期功能
items: 小程序现已支持投稿协作、语音转写与更沉浸的聊天输入体验
聊天个性化、广场日期浏览、QQ 来源展示与身份绑定已与网页版保持一致
通知渠道管理与邮件提醒间隔已同步更新

en.title: Recent features arrive in the mini program
items: The mini program now supports collaborative submissions, audio transcripts, and a more immersive chat composer
Chat personalization, Square date browsing, QZone source details, and QQ identity binding now match the web experience
Notification channel management and email reminder intervals have also been updated
